### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — WO2 defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 2 |
| **Summary** | No PPR-specific AI policy page could be retrieved (Wiley's journal-specific guide.htm at onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/19331592/homepage/guide.htm returned HTTP 402 to automated fetch, and no PPR-specific AI clause surfaced in search). What is documented is Wiley's PUBLISHER-WIDE policy, which PPR is presumed to inherit absent evidence of an override: generative AI/LLMs cannot be listed as author; any AI use in preparing a manuscript must be disclosed (tool name, version, purpose/extent) in the cover letter and/or manuscript; authors must not upload unpublished manuscripts/figures/data to public AI tools; AI-generated content must be reviewed and verified by the human author who takes full responsibility. This is disclosure-gated, not a flat ban, but restricts unverified/undisclosed generative use - rated toward the restrictive end (2/5). Confidence is low because the fact is inferred from publisher-level policy, not a page confirmed to be PPR's own. |
| **Source URL** | https://www.wiley.com/en-us/publish/article/ai-guidelines/ |

### Preprint Policy

> WO2 research note (not broken down per-stage — see docs/workorders/WO2_SOFT_METADATA_BATCH.md for why): Journal-specific PPR preprint clause not directly verified (Wiley guide.htm inaccessible, HTTP 402). Per Wiley's general publisher-wide preprint/self-archiving policy, which subscription humanities journals like PPR normally follow: authors may post/retain a preprint on a preprint server before and during submission, and may self-archive the accepted (peer-reviewed) manuscript after an embargo period - standard embargo for Social Sciences & Humanities (SSH) journals is 24 months (vs 12 months for STM).
> Source: https://authors.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/open-access/preprints-policy.html
